name: The Heart of the Mountain
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
For years I have sought a certain gem.  It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist!  The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.

So I must resort to force.

Fight your way to the Lower Vault of Blackrock Depths, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart.  To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!

Good luck.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have the heart! Amazing! It is even more beautiful than I imagined!

Please, adventurer, take this as payment!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the Heart of the Mountain?  To me, its value is without limit.
